text: The security team approves every production service account.
Production service account credentials must rotate every 90 days.
Contractor access is revoked within four hours of the recorded end date.
Access audit records are retained for 365 days.
Production access requires hardware backed multifactor authentication.
Emergency access expires after two hours unless security renews it.
Resource owners review access permissions every quarter.
Application secrets belong in the managed secret vault, never in source control.
Critical incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.
Critical incident status updates are sent every 30 minutes.
The on call incident commander coordinates critical incidents.
The incident review is due within three business days after resolution.
Standard support requests receive an initial response within eight business hours.
Customer incident updates are published on the public status page.
Standard support operates Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC.
An incident review includes the timeline, contributing factors, and assigned follow up actions.
A production deployment requires approval from two maintainers.
The regular production release window is Tuesday from 14:00 to 16:00 UTC.
The release is rolled back when its error rate exceeds two percent for five minutes.
A canary deployment is observed for 20 minutes before full rollout.
The change author cannot act as the only release approver.
A verified database backup and a tested recovery procedure are required before migration.
Emergency deployments require one incident commander approval and a review the next business day.
Deployment logs are retained for 180 days.
The domestic hotel reimbursement limit is 180 dollars per night before tax.
The international hotel reimbursement limit is 240 dollars per night before tax.
Domestic flights should be booked at least 14 days before departure.
Travel expense claims are due within 30 days after the trip ends.
The department director approves international business travel.
The daily meal allowance for domestic trips is 65 dollars.
An itemized receipt is required for each expense above 25 dollars.
Employees pay all incremental costs of personal extensions to a work trip.
Customer support transcripts are retained for 180 days after case closure.
Deleted customer data may remain in encrypted backups for up to 35 days.
The privacy officer approves exceptions to data retention limits.
A legal hold suspends normal deletion for the affected records.
Anonymized usage aggregates are retained for 24 months.
An approved deletion request is processed within 30 calendar days.
The data governance team owns the retention inventory.
An approved purpose and an access review are required before exporting customer data.
